name: Operator Pass
job: Record each review pass on a piece of work as a row: the lens and its question, what it found, and the ruling (held, changed or broke).

anatomy.role: Who ran the pass (mono caps) and the question it asks
What the pass found or ran, with any command in `code`
Held (green: the work held under the test), Changed (cyan: an action was taken), Broke (red: the check failed), then what changed

states.name: Held, changed, broke
states.note: One ruling word a row, coloured by its one meaning.

states.name: Phone width
states.note: Below 38rem lens, found and ruling stack.

use_when: A glass box: how a page or decision was reviewed, pass by pass.
Every pass ran for real; a pass that did not run is not listed.
avoid_when: Do not list a pass as run when it was only planned; say Not run.

Do not colour Changed gold: gold means a limit. Colour has one meaning across the kit (arc weld spec 4.3): red a failed check, gold a limit, green proven, cyan an action or focus, plain (steel) unknown, magenta a paradox.

data.type: {lens, question, found, ruling: held | changed | broke, note}
data.note: `found` may hold a command in backticks.

access: Each pass reads in order lens, found, ruling; the ruling is a word, not only a colour.

gates: `kit_specimen.py --check` (in scripts): this page matches its spec.
`kit_primitive_sync.py --check`: every page that marks this block carries it line for line.
`artifact_wrap_lint.py` and `page_gate.py` on every page that carries it; sweep 360 to 1440, including 700 to 1000.
